doc.name: fullmakt-a2a
doc.description: Fullmakt management agent: create and manage collections, requests, environments, policies and agent identities in one workspace. Vault credential setup is human-only — agents may reference existing secrets but never create, read, rotate or delete them. Execution (calling a collection's requests as tools) happens over MCP at https://fullmakt.ai/mcp/{collection} with an execution-scoped token from the same token endpoint.

scopes.management: Manage the workspace this client was provisioned for.

skills.name: Get workspace
skills.description: Summary of the workspace this token manages.

skills.name: List collections
skills.description: List the collections in the workspace.

skills.name: Create collection
skills.description: Create a collection in the workspace.

skills.name: Get collection
skills.description: Full collection detail: items tree, variables, scripts.

skills.name: Update collection
skills.description: Update name/description/auth/default environment/scripts.

collection.description: UpdateCollectionRequest: name, description?, authConfigJson?, preRequestScript?, testScript?, defaultEnvironmentId?

skills.name: Delete collection
skills.description: Delete a collection and everything in it.

skills.name: Create item
skills.description: Create a folder or request (HTTP/GraphQL/WebSocket/gRPC/MCP) in a collection.

item.description: CreateCollectionItemRequest: itemType, name, description?, parentItemId?, protocolType?, request?, graphQlRequest?, webSocketRequest?, grpcRequest?, mcpRequest?

skills.name: Get item
skills.description: Fetch one item with its request definition and children.

skills.name: Update item
skills.description: Update an item's name, request definition and scripts.

skills.name: Delete item
skills.description: Delete an item (and its children).

skills.name: Move item
skills.description: Re-parent and/or re-order an item within its collection.

newParentId.description: New parent item GUID, omit for root

skills.name: List environments
skills.description: List the workspace's environments.

skills.name: Create environment
skills.description: Create an environment with variables. Variables may reference existing vault entries (vault://local/<name>) but LLM provider credentials cannot be set over A2A.

skills.name: Update environment
skills.description: Rename an environment and/or replace its variables. Any stored LLM credential config is preserved untouched.

skills.name: Delete environment
skills.description: Delete an environment.

skills.name: Get global variables
skills.description: List the workspace's global variables.

skills.name: Set global variables
skills.description: Replace the workspace's global variables.

skills.name: Get collection policy
skills.description: Read the policy document governing broker calls to a collection.

skills.name: Set collection policy
skills.description: Propose a new policy document (hardDeny / requireApproval / behavior rules) for a collection. The change is not applied: it returns status pending_approval and takes effect only after a person approves it in Fullmakt.

policyJson.description: The policy document as a JSON string

skills.name: List pending approvals
skills.description: List approvals awaiting a human decision. Deciding them is human-only.

skills.name: List agent principals
skills.description: List the account's agent principals. Principals are account-level identities (not workspace-scoped), so this spans the owner's whole account.

skills.name: Create agent principal
skills.description: Create a named account-level agent identity for execution-side auditing and policy.

skills.name: List execution clients
skills.description: List account-level OAuth clients for the remote MCP execution surface (no secrets returned).

skills.name: Create execution client
skills.description: Create an OAuth client scoped to collections in this workspace. The secret is returned exactly once.

collectionIds.description: Collection GUIDs the client may scope tokens to

skills.name: List vault entry references
skills.description: Metadata for existing vault entries (names + vault://local/<name> references). Values are never returned, and secrets can only be created, rotated or deleted by a human in the UI.

skills.name: Query the audit trail
skills.description: Recent broker/A2A audit entries for this account.

skills.name: Import Postman collection
skills.description: Import a Postman v2.1 collection JSON into the workspace.

skills.name: Export Postman collection
skills.description: Export a collection as Postman v2.1 JSON.

skills.name: Probe an API surface
skills.description: Run the discovery ladder (OpenAPI/GraphQL/MCP/A2A, plus mail and file servers) against a URL and return the normalized operations, connections and auth summary. Reads only — persists nothing.

url.description: Absolute URL to probe: http(s), imap/smtp/pop3/mailto, or sftp/ftps

skills.name: Generate a collection from a URL
skills.description: Discover an API and generate a persisted, authenticated collection wired to credential references (never plaintext secrets). Same pipeline as the REST generate endpoint.

url.description: Absolute URL to generate from: http(s) API, imap/smtp/pop3/mailto mailbox, or sftp/ftps server

environmentId.description: Environment GUID scoping the collection (its LLM config is used for HTTP APIs; mail/file targets work without one)

hint.description: Optional intent hint to filter/name endpoints

skills.name: Plan an integration from a sentence
skills.description: Start an assistant run: the free-text wish is decomposed into connector targets and the run pauses on its first question. Returns the run (transcript, plan, pending question). Never returns secrets.

message.description: What the agent should be able to do

environmentId.description: Environment GUID providing the LLM config (default: workspace's)

parentRunId.description: Completed run to amend (allow writes, rotate secret, remint)

skills.name: Get an assistant run
skills.description: Current state, transcript, plan and pending question of a run started by this principal's owner.

skills.name: Answer an assistant run question
skills.description: Answer the run's pending question (confirm_plan, connection_params, scope, agent_identity, confirm_provision). credential and oauth_consent questions are human-only and are refused. When the run completes, the one-time handoff (client secret, tokens) is returned exactly once.

answer.description: The typed answer payload for the question

skills.name: List upstream OAuth grant references
skills.description: Metadata for existing upstream OAuth grants (names + oauth://<name> references, provider, scopes, status). Secrets and tokens are never returned; grants are created, connected and deleted by a human in the UI.
